$comment: Owners named by FND-01 deliverable 2 for root scripts that no workspace package implements yet.
tools/workspace-script.mjs prints `<name>: not implemented yet (owner: <ticket>, module <module>)`
and exits 0. Both the message and its test read this file, so they cannot drift apart.
PRD section 45.3 is normative: a command is never deleted from the list, only implemented by its owner.
An entry LEAVES `owners` the moment its owning ticket implements it in a workspace member, and stays
in `rootScripts` forever. FND-04 (sub-PRD D22) removed `generate` and `generated:check`: they are now
provided by packages/contracts, so tools/workspace-script.mjs delegates for real instead of printing
an owner line. tools/tests/scripts.test.mjs asserts that transition rather than the old empty state.
